channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from FMallSectionsDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: The Illusion of One Voice in Wartime
item.description: The Iran war, the China threat, and the perils of limited military advice.

item.title: Massachusetts Court Blocks Town from Erecting Statues of Christian Heroes
item.description: A court ruled that a town cannot honor police and firefighters with statues of patron saints, citing religious establishment concerns.

item.title: NY Mag Shifts Stance on Noncitizen Voting
item.description: After dismissing noncitizen voting as imaginary, the magazine now argues it could be beneficial, a change critics note aligns with political interests.

item.title: Michigan Democrats' Land Acknowledgment Awkward at Convention
item.description: A land acknowledgment intended to unify the Michigan Democratic convention instead caused an awkward public moment.
